name: unlimited-ocr
description: Local document parsing with baidu/Unlimited-OCR (MIT, 3B-total/500M-active MoE): markdown + LaTeX + layout bounding boxes, on Apple Silicon via MLX or an NVIDIA GPU via transformers. Ships the empirically-established working invocation — the prompt the upstream README documents decodes infinite garbage on MLX — plus a figure segmenter that turns the model's refusal to describe charts into a pre-processing step.
